page.title: Norvane Bank vs other regional banks
page.text:
Bank Compare
Norvane Bank compared with three other regional banks
Our rating: 4 out of 5

We compared account fees, savings rates and app ratings for Norvane Bank and three rivals.

Good
Competitive savings rates
Helpful branch staff
Not so good
App could be faster
Overdraft fees are high

Norvane Bank came second overall. It is a good option if you value branch access.
